text:
morgan: quick sync 1: cross-service cutover in 25m. Plan: API=v2.4.0, runtime=kernel-qt1.5, console=5.9.0, router=header-split-v3 staged. rolling percentages: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100%. any blockers?

alex: looks good. request we insert a 5m pause between 25% and 75% to watch KV and cache eviction. last time we saw a spike.

emily: console will flip feature-flag for assets at +10m. i'll lower CDN TTL to 30s for 20m. updating release notes with the asset-rollout caveat. :memo:

sasha: fyi security scan passed but there's a new CSP header change in console; will coordinate with router team for header passthrough.

jay: observability ready. healthchecks: 1) /health 2) /v1/embeddings/ping 3) /v1/chat/ping. thresholds: p95 latency > 200ms or 0.8% error rate sustained 2m -> auto rollback. i'll post canary results.

deploy-bot: deploy request queued by morgan: "cutover-7991234567". scheduled to start at 7991235710 (in 25m). Pins applied: API=2.4.0, Runtime=kernel-qt1.5. Rollback window: 60m post-cutover. To cancel: `/deploy cancel cutover-7991234567`. Status will stream here.

morgan: rollback plan and order? runtime -> api -> router -> console? want to confirm sequence and rollback targets.

alex: agree runtime first (kernel rollback -> kernel-qt1.4), then api (v2.3.9), then router (revert header-split), then console (5.8.x). runtime rollback reduces risk of malformed kernel paths.

emily: note: console asset rollback requires clearing edge cache, might take a few mins. prefer to keep console last.

sasha: if CSP issues appear, router revert first might be needed to avoid broken headers for clients. keep that as exception.

jay: i'll run final smoke at T-5 and post a short table: `api_ok: true, runtime_kernel: kernel-qt1.4, router_canary: none` and quick latency metrics. who can approve unpin at +15? @alex @sasha

alex: i'll approve at +15 if p95 < 120ms and no errors.

sasha: same. i'll watch CSP logs.

morgan: thx. small request: include a manual gate at 25% to let SRE confirm KV eviction is stable. add that to deploy bot runbook?

deploy-bot: acknowledged. will pause at 25% and post `PAUSE_FOR_KV_CHECK` with a 10m timer. Manual resume: `/deploy resume cutover-7991234567`. Auto-abort conditions: listed thresholds.

jay: copied. i'll be on-call and will post canary outputs every step. planning to run `curl -i -H "x-debug: canary" https://api.staging.redwood/health` and `jq '.kernel'` on responses.

emily: i'll stand by for console rollback ops if needed. set me as primary for edge invalidation.

morgan: ok great. anyone want to add preflight smoke commands to the thread so we have them in one place?

jay: preflight at T-6: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.test/health | jq -r '.status'` and `curl -sS -H 'x-runtime-kernel: current' https://api.redwood.test/headers | jq -r '.kernel'`

alex: also run quick load test with `hey -z 15s -q 50 -c 10 https://api.redwood.test/chat` to watch tail latency. keep it low.

morgan: perfect. i'll ping this thread at start and post final cutover note. thanks all. :rocket:
